name: Ascending Hunger

Traits.name: Listening Slats
Traits.text: While a creature stands or moves on a surface connected to one the hunger can reach, within its tremorsense range, the hunger pinpoints the hunger's position even if it is unseen, hidden, or behind cover.
Traits.clause: The hunger's segmented slats are its ears. It senses the vibration of any creature standing or moving on a connected sur

Traits.name: Restless Rise
Traits.text: The hunger ignores Difficult Terrain, and Opportunity Attacks against it are made with Disadvantage.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The hunger makes three Step-Edge attacks. It can replace one attack with a Swallowing Step attack.

Actions.name: Step-Edge
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Swallowing Step (Beast or Hybrid Form Only)
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 15. *Failure:* The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

Bonus Actions.name: Shape-Shift
Bonus Actions.text: The hunger shape-shifts into a Large beast-humanoid hybrid or a Medium beast, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

Bonus Actions.name: Fleet Agility
Bonus Actions.text: The hunger takes the Dash or Disengage action.

lore: In stairwells where a wanting went unanswered too long, the steps themselves grew hungry and learned to climb.
